title: Why A Starlink Test In Italy Has Iran's Internet Censors Worried
content: A Starlink trial on an Italian hilltop connected an ordinary smartphone to the Internet without mobile coverage, a satellite dish, or an external antenna. title: Deep Debt, Failing Health: Afghans Desperate To Escape Poverty Sell Kidneys To Survive
content: As millions of Afghans struggle just to afford food, some have turned to selling one of their last remaining resources: a healthy kidney. The costs can be devastating: One woman said her health has deteriorated since she sold a kidney for a modest sum that failed to clear her family's debts.
